value.text: Consent Form

This study is conducted by Gilad Feldman and colleagues (the psychology department at University of Hong Kong). If you have questions or concerns regarding this project, please do not hesitate to contact Gilad Feldman gfeldman@hku.hk at any time.
Purpose of the study
The purpose of the current study is to understand how people think and feel over their own actions in various types of social situations.
Procedures.

This study will ask you to complete a set of questionnaires requiring making judgments regarding various scenarios. The duration of this study has been indicated on the task that you accepted. It is very important for you to both read the scenario account carefully and imagine what the person's experience would be like.
Potential risks.
The current study has no known risks greater than those of ordinary daily life.
Potential benefits.
The current study will bring you no direct benefits.
Compensation.
Compensation is offered through the online platform. The level of compensation has been indicated on the task that you accepted.
Confidentiality.

Your questionnaire responses are anonymous and strictly confidential. No personal identifiers are kept. Information obtained will only be used as aggregates for research purposes. Deidentified/Anonymized version of the data with no confidential data will be shared publicly to allow the reproduction and reproducibility of our research.
Participation and withdrawal.

Your participation is voluntary. This means that you can choose to stop at any time without any negative consequences. If at any time you wish to withdraw, please simply indicate eight zeros as your completion code, and you will receive compensation regardless.
Questions and concerns

If you have any questions about the research, please feel free to contact Gilad Feldman at the University of Hong Kong (gfeldman@hku.hk). If you have questions about your rights as a research participant, contact the Human Research Ethics Committee, HKU (+852 2241-5267). #EA210265
Please print a copy of this consent form for your records, if you so desire.
When you're ready to begin, please select >> (Next) to proceed to the study.

value.text: Study Outline

You will be asked to read hypothetical accounts of events that could happen to people such as yourself. During the process, please read the accounts carefully, and try your best to imagine yourself as the central person in the scenario, and what you would be thinking and feeling as that person.
Parts:
Brief demographic questions (1 question, 1 page)
Hypothetical scenario + comprehension questions (2 questions, 1 page)
Questions about the scenario (38 questions; 1 page)
Brief feedback and additional demographics (3 pages)
Overall: 7 pages.
For opinion related questions - There are no “right” or “wrong” opinion answers, so please share your opinion as honestly as possible.
Before we begin the survey, we would just like to verify with you some questions to make sure that you qualify to participate in this study.
